cause: The mounted prepared source directory had mode0700 owned by the host user. Container UID10001 could not traverse it.
correction: Created a separate project-scoped public-artifact copy using reflink where available; verified the full source manifest and all file hashes, made only that copy readable, and atomically published it. Original prepared-cache directory mode0700 retained.
orchestration_change: Use the verified readable artifact copy and test selected bind-mount readability with the exact image, runc and no visible GPUs before starting references or GPU containers.
scope: Startup failure and CPU permission diagnosis only; not successful GPU or Compose certification
